verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents 288 GB of HBM per B300 GPU (2.3 TB across 8 GPUs in DGX B300), which comfortably holds a quantized 70B-class model on a single GPU. NVIDIA also positions the platform for LLM inference with 144 PFLOPS FP4, so single-node inference is clearly supported. The community comment about home power draw concerns local deployment practicality, not whether the capability exists. missing for 10: published per-GPU memory bandwidth figure, hands-on or independent 70B quantized inference benchmarks.
